boards.name: Linear Snake
boards.description: 20 spaces in a straight line laid out as a snake. Win by reaching the finish and answering the Grand Prize, or by collecting all 4 HQ tokens.

boards.name: Classic Loop
boards.description: 24 spaces in a closed loop. There is no finish: win by collecting all 4 HQ tokens, or have the best score after 12 rounds.

boards.name: Forked Paths
boards.description: A linear track with two forks. Fork 1: a short branch with a penalty, or a longer one with a roll-again. Fork 2: a direct penalty path, or a scenic detour past two HQs.

boards.name: Loop with Shortcut
boards.description: A 20-space loop with a 4-space shortcut down the middle. The shortcut has the only Pop Culture HQ and a penalty. Collect all tokens, or have the best score after 10 rounds.

boards.name: Special Spaces Sandbox
boards.description: A short track full of special spaces, played with a 4-sided die and a 15 s timer. Good for testing roll-again caps, penalty skips and wildcard choices.
